Remote Proctoring Solutions for Canada
Locally Hosted, Locally Supported, Globally Trusted
Book a Demo
2500+ Global Recruiters in Amazing Companies Like These Use Talview
With growing demand for secure, locally delivered online exam monitoring, Canadian institutions are prioritizing data sovereignty, local support, and trusted partnerships. Talview’s Canada Remote Proctoring Solution is built to meet those needs combining Canadian data residency, local proctoring teams, and award-winning AI technology to deliver the highest standard of exam integrity.
Why Canada Needs a Local Remote Proctoring Solution
Recent trade tensions between Canada and the U.S. have raised concerns about cross-border data access and dependence on U.S. based service providers.
Canadian universities, colleges, professional certification boards, and government agencies now prefer solutions that are:
Hosted entirely within Canada, ensuring compliance with Canadian privacy laws.
Staffed with local human resources including proctors, support, and engineering.
Managed through Canadian contracts via local resellers and business partners.
Compliant with PIPEDA and, where applicable, provincial privacy regulations.
Talview’s Canadian Remote Proctoring Infrastructure
Canadian Data Residency
All candidate data is stored and processed in Canadian data centres.
Redundant hosting ensures availability across regions.
No cross-border data transfers — no U.S. jurisdiction over your exam data.
Local Proctoring Teams
Canadian-based human proctors for live and recorded review.
Multilingual capability, including English and French, to meet national accessibility requirements.
Local Resellers and Partnerships
Contracting via Canadian resellers ensures smooth procurement and compliance with local vendor requirements.
On-the-ground customer success teams for faster response times.
Local Human Resources
Talview employs Canadian-based proctors, support staff, and technical engineers.
Professional services delivered from within Canada.
Security and Compliance
Talview’s Canadian Remote Proctoring is designed to meet:
PIPEDA (Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act)
Provincial privacy laws such as Ontario’s Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (FIPPA) and Quebec’s Law 25.
Industry-leading ISO 27001 and SOC 2 security standards
How Talview Remote Proctoring Works
Identity Verification
AI-powered ID checks ensure the right candidate takes the exam.
Secure Exam Environment
Talview Secure Browser prevents tab-switching, screen sharing, and unauthorised applications.
Agentic AI Monitoring
Alvy, Talview’s patented AI proctor, monitors behaviour in real time, escalating issues to human proctors as needed.
Audit-Ready Reports
Detailed logs, recordings, and incident reports for compliance and dispute resolution.

Local hosting and data residency in Canada.

FAQs: Remote Proctoring in Canada
Is Talview’s Canadian Remote Proctoring compliant with PIPEDA?
Yes, all data is stored and processed within Canadian borders, with no access from outside Canada.
Do you have Canadian proctors?
Yes, we have live and review proctors based in Canada, with multilingual capabilities.
Can you integrate with our Canadian LMS or exam engine?
Yes, Talview integrates with major platforms including Moodle, Brightspace (D2L), and Blackboard.
How quickly can you get us live?
Most Canadian customers are operational within 2–4 weeks.
